title: Petra and the Safehouse
author: Ulyana Eriksen
blurb: Ada Dunmore, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
